citations.id: SQLite subquery flattening and deferred work

notes: Identity-first page selection retains the source existence/name join, then projects only final page payloads. Old SQLite top-N already skipped some losing rows; no claim that it projected every candidate. Deterministic tests prove fewer payload evaluations, not a timing threshold. Initial sequential native comparisons showed large improvements; alternating fully warm reads were only slightly faster (about36.5–37.7ms before,33.8–35.5ms after), so cache/order effects remain explicit. Historic7499ms disk-contention incident was not reproduced and complete timeout resolution is not claimed. All query/API/time/size/cap/security/source-admission contracts remain unchanged; no database or index write is needed. Candidate gateway uses exact installed files with one code overlay and an explicitly new canonical manifest, not a recreated unknown legacy digest algorithm. Local activation, hosted checks, review and deployment remain separate from this authorship/integrity record.
